recipe.title: Appledore Soup
recipe.instructions: Peel and dice potatoes, boil until tender and drain. Mash well. Heat milk gently with the onion, remove onion and stir milk into potatoes. recipe.title: Baked Macaroni with Cheese
recipe.instructions: Heat oven to 190 C (375 F). Boil macaroni in salted water until just tender and drain. Melt 2 tablespoons butter, stir in flour and cook 1 minute. recipe.title: Chicken Stew
recipe.instructions: Cover chicken pieces with water in a large pot. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender and at least 74 C (165 F), about 60-75 minutes. Season. recipe.title: Chicken Timbales II
recipe.instructions: Heat oven to 175 C (350 F). Melt butter in a saucepan, add breadcrumbs and milk and stir over low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly. recipe.instructions: Warm milk gently with onion and then remove onion. Mix flour and water into a smooth slurry and whisk into milk. Simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking. recipe.instructions: Wash leeks thoroughly and slice with celery. Soften in 2 1/2 tablespoons butter for 10 minutes. Add milk and cook very gently, stirring often, for 35-40 minutes.
